headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Housing Construction is just moving dirt back and forth/leaving ROW in an unsafe condition. Roadway is not repaired including the recently built shared use path by the Transportation Department. Please send an inspector to the site to help them get their act together

Hi! There are two wide potholes in the right lane of southbound South Lamar at the Barton Skyway intersection, right in front of 7-11. Many cars shift to the extreme left side of the lane, or the extreme right to avoid the holes, creating dangerous situations. It would be great if these two sections could be patched up. There are hundreds of homes/families in Barton Hills that this affects on a da

There are several trash, recycling, and compost bins left out on the street in front of 2007 Maxwell Ln that do not belong to us our any of our neighbors.  Please pick them up as they may have been left by a prior neighbor or tenant!

Planters blocking bike lane (AGAIN!!). They have been here since at least Sunday. This has happened multiple times in the past too. SB Guadalupe St. bike lane between 22nd & 21st. Could cause a serious crash.

I’ve submitted a 311 request before for the same park regarding mowing issues. I don’t know why it’s not regularly maintained since it’s a public park, but please let me know if I need to continue to submit a new request every time the park needs to be mowed. This park is severely overgrown, and when they mowed last time, it was a very chopped job. About six months ago It used to be mowed and clea

From house construction at 7812, there is a ton of mud and debris in the street. Street needs a clean, not just a sweep or please make that property owner take care of it. It’s unfortunate because the street was just resurfaced some months ago

Completed. Larger NO RIGHT ON RED required at this intersection from FM 1825 turning right on to Wells Branch Pkwy. The current sign is not seen by drivers. Masses of right turns on red are occurring daily with zero enforcement. Dangerous intersection with construction in the mix.
items.address: W Wells Branch Pkwy & Fm 1825 Rd, Austin

items.text: Today was the third live DJ event in the last six weeks with portable speakers pointed at the nearby residential buildings. It’s hosted by the Taquero Mucho and the Minimo Matcha truck at 508 West Ave. Taquero Mucho’s SIP explicitly prohibits live DJs with portable speakers, and Minimo doesn’t have an OMV permit. Loud music with a bass track is so heavy, that it’s impossible to escape it within ou

My neighbors, whose dogs are aggressive towards my dogs continue to allow their dogs to roam around the apartment building without a leash. There is a small white dog owned by a woman named Michelle in 201 and a black dog owned by a man named Austin in 205. This creates a dangerous situation when I’m out walking my dog.

Dozens of vehicles parked illegally in private and public fire lanes for Sunday flea market. Location is near the intersection of Long spur and North Lamar, and the private driveway at 9815 N. Lamar. I’m out here Please call code investigator Britt 512-420-6386

A Ford Escape is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed. This car needs to be towed.

The creek behind our house is full of debris brought by recent rain. When the creek gets debris it blocks the culvert allowing the water to raise and flood our homes. It happened last year, which affected three of our neighbors. Please send a crew to clean the creek. 
Home location. 5006 highland ct Austin TX 78731

Couple that live at 3202 Santa Fe Dr do not keep their dogs on leashes and they’re not trained. I was pinned against a tree with my dog while the 2 dogs barked and wouldn’t let us walk away. The owners are reckless and irresponsible and need to be fined. We have asked multiple times for their dogs to be leashed for safety reasons.

Dead bat STILL on the trail right next to the community dock below the Rainey St trailhead. It's directly on the base of the big tree right from the community dock (see pictures). it's a big Bat and can hardly be not seen.
THIS IS NOT A DUPLICATE. THE JOB WAS INCOMPLETE. I watched the street sweeper pass my house and the towel is STILL THERE.

For the Department- transportation & public works: I live on 4611 Depew Avenue. They are currently working on a street sealing project on my block. How long are they scheduled to be working on this project? I have movers coming on Tuesday July 28th and this will impact my move if they are still working on the street.

Dog is routinely left outside for extended periods and barks for hours. Today the dog has been outside in approximately 102°F heat for much of the day. I have also observed the dog being left outside during a thunderstorm on a previous occasion. I am concerned about the dog's welfare and request that Animal Protection conduct a welfare check.

A homeless person has moved into the community garden
St. David Foundation Community Garden at MLK Park.
It is sponsored by city of Austin parks and recreation
Also Check behind the shed since they’ve been stealing the hose to shower back there

A black SUV is parked at the corner of 2nd and Nueces Street in a no-parking zone. The vehicle blocks both a fire hydrant and a stop sign, obstructing visibility for drivers traveling south on Nueces and preventing them from seeing pedestrians in the crosswalk or vehicles heading east on 2nd Street. This creates a safety hazard for pedestrians, drivers, and could delay access to the fire hydrant i

Property being dumped from 1602 Gregory is blocking the public right of way.  What the f*** is the city doing continuing to let this accumulate?  This has been collecting for years now.  This should not be allowed or tolerated.

Music and bass excessively loud on the south end of Rainey street near Half step / Rainey house. Bass vibrating my apartment building. It’s 11:53pm. I have a noise machine on + 2 fans and can still hear the music on top of feeling the bass in my body.

My neighbor is not taking care of her cats. They are indoor cats that cry to be let in all night. They never left them in the house and have no food or water outside for them. Its really hot outside and they come into my yard to drink bird bath water. Im afraid they will get sick or worse.

My neighbors dogs are being neglected. The balcony is always covered in feces and urine. The tenants clean it maybe once every 2 weeks or so. The dogs eat and lie in the filth everyday. I’ve complained to property management 3 times and no action has been taken.

Our neighbors have adopted two house cats and have kept them outside in this extreme heat with no water and little to no shelter. They roam around our property and through our backyard. They also cry at the backdoor every night wanting inside as they are obviously indoor cats being forced to live outside. Its cruel.

We are seeing approximately 4 to 5 raccoons that appear to be nesting in 903 Lambeth Ln chimney. I don't have my neighbors contact information and the gate to the front door is locked. They look like they have done considerable damage. I will attempt to contact but we do not see them out often so I am just trying to make them aware

Dumpsters blocking bike lane again.  They put these out on Friday and the trash comes on Monday, they block the bike lane half the week.  I’ve put on multiple requests and last time it be was noted that the management said they’d work with maintenance to correct this.  They cannot put the dumpsters in the street even for a day.  I’ll let putting in requests until this is resolved.

Owner of property (5203 Avenue H) building ADU is unresponsive and allows construction workers to obstruct one-way alley with multiple vehicles for months now. Nails and screws are also left where people drive and pets walk.

Grey vehicle, as shown in picture, has multiple instances of parking in No Parking zones to meet-up with 1 or more vehicles and loiter for hours. He has been warned by building security at least 3 times but continues to operate his shady business in same location. Their vehicles are on City property, in an alleyway behind private property.

vehicle is still obstructing and illegally parked in our permitted valet lane. Citation was issued but vehicle remains parked 3hrs past our operating hours as posted pending tow away due to printer technical issue. I was instructed by the parking enforcement officer to submit a new service request if the vehicle remained in the valet for a longer period.

Car parked and no parking zone. The curb where it is parked as clearly marked as no parking. This is the same car that got reported this morning and the officer attending said there was not an issue. But they were clearly wrong. And not paying attention. On 29th St. side of property.

Hundreds Razor blades dumped on sidewalk mainly in front of bus stop but all some on sidewalk going north toward 4th. Trash bin has also been turned over . Public safety concern as the blades especially will spread & could end up in grass posing a risk to anyone including children & animals walking by

Traffic congestion at the intersection of Pearce Lane and FM 973 has become a major issue during peak traffic hours. Vehicles waiting to turn right onto FM 973 frequently back up along Pearce Lane, often extending past SH 130 and sometimes as far as Ross Road. Adding a dedicated right-turn lane from Pearce Lane onto FM 973 would significantly improve traffic flow, reduce congestion and wait times,

Traffic signal coming out of Barton Creek Mall onto 360 has been a problem between 5 AM and 6 AM this whole week. It turns red for the traffic on 360 for an extended period of time, even though there are no cars coming out of the mall at all.
items.address: 2825 S Capital of Texas Hwy NB, Austin

items.text: Traffic signal timing at Parmer Lane/I-35 is causing traffic back ups at Parmer/Lamar. Signal seems to stay green for a very long time for some directions, while others wait for a long time, which cascades into sitting through multiple light cycles with traffic backed up.

Water “channel” to retention pond has lots of debris clogging the tunnels under the road. Mostly tree branches and such, it seems. Additionally, the small hills/barriers to slow the rushing water have totally disappeared on the north side of Meadowsouth Ln and are slowly disappearing in the south side.

Man was seen hitting the dog with a stick and broom, and throwing debris in their backyard at the dog, and threatening the dog with a weedwacker from 10:20 pm to around 11 pm last night. 911 was called but reporting to 311 as well

Homeless panhandlers with multiple dogs out here on this corner daily for the past 3 days. These dogs do not deserve to be outside in near 100 degree weather all day. Scofield ridge parkway right outside Magnolia Scofield Ridge.
several cars are parked illegally (im the bike lane) on northbound South Pleasant valley Road, near the Cap Metro bus stop. they have been doing thos for several days and it needs to be deterred.
Colton Bluff Springs Rd between McKinney Falls Pkwy and Alum Rock Dr needs repaving / potholes fixed. The road has several large cracks down the middle and on the sides and several potholes.

Pothole in street at 4604 Burnet Rd.  It’s in the right lane at the entrance to Hollywood Feed. It’s close to the curb but I still hit it often.  It’s been patched numerous times before; it’s time for a more permanent fix.
